     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# run-arms.sh — cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm driver (SDD D-2.3, DEC-0164, DEC-0171)
     4	#
     5	# Runs the declared control arms of one recall suite on a frozen fixture batch
     6	# against a detached git worktree pinned at --source-commit (never the live
     7	# tree), interleaving trials across arms so provider drift spreads evenly.
     8	#
     9	# Usage:
    10	#   run-arms.sh --suite review-recall|audit-recall --arms a,b,c
    11	#               --fixtures pr-01,pr-02,… --trials 3 --source-commit <sha>
    12	#               [--model <id>] [--concurrency 2] [--batch <name>]
    13	#               [--results-dir evals/results/arms] [--retry-wait <s>]
    14	#               [--allow-unapproved] [--dry-run]
    15	#
    16	# Per trial (fixture × arm × trial), in this order:
    17	#   1. the fixture's SHA256SUMS entries (its files, hidden manifest and labels)
    18	#      are verified; a drift stops the batch (state failed, exit 3). The whole
    19	#      corpus is verified once at batch start (digest in MANIFEST.json); each
    20	#      row records the SHA256SUMS digest seen at its trial, so approving another
    21	#      fixture's labels mid-batch is visible and harmless
    22	#   2. evals/harness/sandbox.sh creates the sandbox from the frozen fixture
    23	#   3. execute-agent.sh runs the executor with EVAL_PROMPT_TREE = the pinned
    24	#      worktree, LOA_EVAL_ARM = the arm (toggles hit the sandbox copy only),
    25	#      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT, EVAL_MODEL
    26	#   4. grade.sh grades it; the row goes to <batch>/<arm>/results.jsonl with
    27	#      arm, trial, source_commit, model_id, seed (null: the CLI route takes
    28	#      none) and run_date; the artifacts go under <batch>/<arm>/artifacts/
    29	#   A trial whose executor fails for a transport reason (timeout, no result
    30	#   event, API error, rate or session limit) is retried once after
    31	#   --retry-wait seconds; a second failure records an error row and the arm
    32	#   ends `partial`. Other executor failures are recorded, not retried.
    33	#
    34	# Layout: <results-dir>/<suite>/<batch>/{MANIFEST.json,STATUS.json,run.log,
    35	#   <arm>/results.jsonl,<arm>/artifacts/…}; <results-dir>/<suite>/STATUS.json
    36	#   aggregates every batch of the suite (the Sprint 2 gate and report.sh

    41	# Exit: 0 complete, 1 partial (some trial failed twice; results kept),

   132	# verify_corpus [<fixture>] — every SHA256SUMS entry (or one fixture's entries
   133	# and its manifest) hashes as recorded. Prints the SHA256SUMS digest.
   134	verify_corpus() {
   135	  python3 -I - "$CORPUS_DIR" "${1:-}" <<'PY'
   136	import hashlib, os, sys
   137	corpus, only = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   138	sums = os.path.join(corpus, "SHA256SUMS")
   139	raw = open(sums, "rb").read()
   140	bad = []
   141	for line in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
   142	    if not line.strip():
   143	        continue
   144	    digest, rel = line.split("  ", 1)
   145	    if only and not (rel.startswith(only + "/") or rel == f"manifests/{only}.json" or rel == "corpus.tsv"
   146	                     or rel.startswith(f"labels/{only}.")):
   147	        continue
   148	    p = os.path.join(corpus, rel)
   149	    if not os.path.isfile(p) or hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest() != digest:
   150	        bad.append(rel)
   151	if bad:
   152	    print("corpus drift: " + ", ".join(bad[:10]), file=sys.stderr)
   153	    sys.exit(1)
   154	print(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
   155	PY
   156	}

   283	# The suite-level STATUS.json merges every batch: counters add per arm; the
   284	# state is failed > running > partial > complete; source/model must agree.
   285	aggregate_status() {
   286	  local agg="$SUITE_DIR/STATUS.json" lockd="$SUITE_DIR/.status.lock" n=0
   287	  until mkdir "$lockd" 2>/dev/null; do n=$((n + 1)); [[ $n -gt 50 ]] && return 0; sleep 0.1; done

   290	    def rank: {"failed": 4, "running": 3, "partial": 2, "complete": 1}[.] // 4;
   291	    (map(.state) | max_by(rank)) as $state |
   292	    {schema_version: 1, suite: $suite, state: $state,
   293	     batches: map({batch, state, started, finished}),
   294	     per_arm: (reduce (.[] | .per_arm | to_entries[]) as $e ({};
   295	        .[$e.key] |= {trials_done: ((.trials_done // 0) + $e.value.trials_done),
   296	                      trials_failed: ((.trials_failed // 0) + $e.value.trials_failed),
   297	                      trials_planned: ((.trials_planned // 0) + $e.value.trials_planned)})),
   298	     source_commit: (map(.source_commit) | unique | if length == 1 then .[0] else "MIXED" end),
   299	     model_id: (map(.model_id) | unique | if length == 1 then .[0] else "MIXED" end),
   300	     started: (map(.started) | min), finished: (if $state == "running" then null else (map(.finished) | max) end)}' \
   301	    $(find "$SUITE_DIR" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name STATUS.json | sort) > "$agg.tmp" 2>/dev/null \
   302	    && mv "$agg.tmp" "$agg"
   303	  rmdir "$lockd" 2>/dev/null || true

   310	  rc="$(jq -r '.exit_code // 0' "$ws/.eval/executor.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"

   314	  grep -qiE 'rate.?limit|overloaded|session limit|usage limit|out of extra usage|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|network|socket hang up|5[0-9][0-9] ' \

   319	run_trial() {  # run_trial <job-id> <arm> <fixture> <trial>
   320	  local jid="$1" arm="$2" fx="$3" trial="$4"
   321	  local task="$EVALS_DIR/tasks/$SUITE/$TASK_PREFIX-$fx.yaml" task_id="$TASK_PREFIX-$fx"
   322	  local run_id="arms-$SUITE-$BATCH" attempt=0 ws="" trial_id status="error" err_json='null'
   323	  local graders='[]' composite='{"strategy":"all_must_pass","pass":false,"score":0}' executor='null'
   324	  local start_ms end_ms per_trial ex_rc
   325	  per_trial="$(yq -r '.timeout.per_trial // 1500' "$task")"
   326	  start_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
   327	  if ! verify_corpus "$fx" >"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.digest" 2>"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.drift"; then
   328	    printf 'DRIFT\n' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.flag"; return 0
   329	  fi
   330	  while [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; do
   331	    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
   332	    trial_id="$run_id-$arm-$fx-t$trial-a$attempt-$jid"
   333	    ws="$("$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" create --fixture "review-prs/$fx" --run-id "$run_id" --trial-id "$trial_id" 2>/dev/null)" \
   334	      || { err_json='{"type":"infrastructure_error","message":"sandbox creation failed"}'; break; }
   335	    ex_rc=0
   336	    EVAL_PROMPT_TREE="$WORKTREE" EVAL_MODEL="$MODEL" LOA_EVAL_ARM="$arm" LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE="$SUITE_FILE" \
   337	      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT="$SRC_FULL" LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1 \
   338	      "$SCRIPT_DIR/execute-agent.sh" --task-yaml "$task" --workspace "$ws" \
   339	        --run-id "$run_id" --trial-id "$trial_id" --timeout "$per_trial" \
   340	        >/dev/null 2>"$JOBS_DIR/$jid.exec.log" || ex_rc=$?
   341	    [[ -f "$ws/.eval/executor.json" ]] && executor="$(cat "$ws/.eval/executor.json")"
   342	    if [[ $ex_rc -eq 0 ]]; then
   343	      local gout gexit=0
   344	      gout="$("$SCRIPT_DIR/grade.sh" --task-yaml "$task" --workspace "$ws" \
   345	        --timeout "$(yq -r '.timeout.per_grader // 60' "$task")" 2>/dev/null)" || gexit=$?
   346	      if jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$gout"; then
   347	        graders="$(jq -c '.graders' <<<"$gout")"; composite="$(jq -c '.composite' <<<"$gout")"
   348	      fi
   349	      if [[ $gexit -le 1 ]]; then status="completed"; err_json='null'
   350	      else err_json='{"type":"infrastructure_error","message":"grader error"}'; fi
   351	      break
   352	    fi
   353	    if [[ $ex_rc -eq 1 ]] && is_transport_failure "$ws"; then
   354	      err_json="$(jq -cn --argjson a "$attempt" '{type:"transport_error",message:"executor transport failure",attempt:$a}')"
   355	      if [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; then
   356	        keep_artifacts "$ws" "$arm" "$task_id" "$trial" "-attempt1"
   357	        "$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" destroy --trial-id "$trial_id" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
   358	        ws=""; executor='null'
   359	        sleep "$RETRY_WAIT"; continue
   360	      fi
   361	    else
   362	      err_json="$(jq -cn --argjson rc "$ex_rc" '{type:(if $rc == 2 then "infrastructure_error" else "agent_error" end),message:("execute-agent exit " + ($rc|tostring))}')"
   363	    fi
   364	    break
   365	  done
   366	  end_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
   367	  if [[ -n "$ws" && -d "$ws" ]]; then

   369	    "$SCRIPT_DIR/sandbox.sh" destroy --trial-id "$trial_id" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
   370	  fi

   372	    --arg fixture "$fx" --arg arm "$arm" --argjson trial "$trial" --argjson attempts "$attempt" \
   373	    --arg status "$status" --arg ts "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --arg run_date "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)" \
   374	    --argjson duration_ms "$(( end_ms - start_ms ))" --arg src "$SRC_FULL" --arg model_req "$MODEL" \

   378	      arm: $arm, trial: $trial, attempts: $attempts, status: $status, timestamp: $ts, run_date: $run_date,
   379	      duration_ms: $duration_ms, source_commit: $src, model_requested: $model_req,
   380	      model_id: ($executor.model_id? // null), model_version: ($executor.model_id? // "none"), seed: null,
   381	      corpus_sha256: $digest, corpus_sha256_at_trial: $digest_now, fixture_verified: true, graders: $graders, composite: $composite, error: $error}
   382	     + (if $executor == null then {} else {executor: $executor} end)' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row.tmp"
   383	  mv "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row.tmp" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"

   426	trap 'log "interrupted"; set_state failed; exit 3' INT TERM HUP
   427	
   428	PIDS=() PJOB=() PARM=()
   429	reap() {  # reap until fewer than $1 jobs run
   430	  local i
   431	  while [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]]; do
   432	    for i in "${!PIDS[@]}"; do
   433	      if ! kill -0 "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null; then
   434	        wait "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null || true
   435	        collect "${PJOB[$i]}" "${PARM[$i]}"
   436	        unset 'PIDS[i]' 'PJOB[i]' 'PARM[i]'
   437	        PIDS=("${PIDS[@]+"${PIDS[@]}"}"); PJOB=("${PJOB[@]+"${PJOB[@]}"}"); PARM=("${PARM[@]+"${PARM[@]}"}")
   438	        break
   439	      fi
   440	    done
   441	    [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]] && sleep 1
   442	  done
   443	  return 0
   444	}
   445	
   446	n=0
   447	for p in "${PLAN[@]}"; do
   448	  IFS='|' read -r a f t <<<"$p"
   449	  n=$((n + 1)); jid="$(printf 'j%04d' "$n")"
   450	  reap "$CONCURRENCY"
   451	  run_trial "$jid" "$a" "$f" "$t" &
   452	  PIDS+=("$!"); PJOB+=("$jid"); PARM+=("$a")
   453	done
   454	reap 1
   455	
   456	total_done=0 total_failed=0
   457	for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do total_done=$(( total_done + ${DONE[$i]} )); total_failed=$(( total_failed + ${FAILED[$i]} )); done
   458	if [[ $total_failed -eq 0 ]]; then
   459	  set_state complete; log "complete: $total_done trials"; exit 0
   460	elif [[ $total_done -eq 0 ]]; then
   461	  set_state failed; log "failed: no trial completed ($total_failed failed)"; exit 3
   462	else
   463	  set_state partial; log "partial: $total_done done, $total_failed failed"; exit 1

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""arms-report.py — the cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm report (SDD D-2.3).
     3	
     4	Invoked by `report.sh --arms`. Reads <results-root>/<suite>/STATUS.json (the
     5	suite aggregate run-arms.sh writes), every batch's MANIFEST.json and
     6	<arm>/results.jsonl, and the suite's pre-registered `ab.threshold` and
     7	`ab.arms`, and writes one markdown report.
     8	
     9	Per arm: recall (mean over defect fixtures of the per-fixture trial mean;
    10	the min, max and spread of the per-trial means), refuted share (cited
    11	findings matching neither a feedback label nor a fix region, over cited
    12	findings, pooled over completed trials), tokens per call, the percentile
    13	bootstrap interval of the recall drop (baseline - arm) resampling fixtures,
    14	the verdict and the missed labels.
    15	
    16	Verdict (pre-registered; never computed for baseline):
    17	  inconclusive  --partial; the run is not complete; a planned fixture lacks
    18	                trials_required completed trials in the arm or the baseline;
    19	                model or source skew; no defect fixture; or only a recall
    20	                rule is violated while the mean drop does not exceed the
    21	                baseline's own trial-to-trial spread (a change too small to name)
    22	  recall loss   the refuted-share rule is violated, or a recall rule is
    23	                violated and the mean drop exceeds the baseline spread
    24	  no recall loss  every rule holds:
    25	                  upper bound of the drop interval <= mean_recall_max_drop
    26	                  arm min trial mean >= baseline min trial mean - min_trial_recall_max_drop
    27	                  arm refuted share <= baseline refuted share + refuted_share_max_rise
    28	An `informational: true` arm's verdict reports a yield only.
    29	
    30	Exit: 0 written, 1 refused (a suite is not complete and --partial was not
    31	given), 2 error. Stdlib only.
    32	"""
    33	import argparse
    34	import datetime
    35	import json
    36	import os
    37	import random
    38	import sys
    39	from collections import Counter, defaultdict
    40	
    41	
    42	def load_yaml_subset(path):
    43	    """The suites are YAML (no stdlib parser); the harness already depends on yq v4."""
    44	    import subprocess
    45	    out = subprocess.run(["yq", "-o=json", ".", path], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    46	    return json.loads(out)
    47	
    48	
    49	def read_jsonl(path):
    50	    rows = []
    51	    if not os.path.isfile(path):
    52	        return rows
    53	    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    54	        for line in fh:
    55	            line = line.strip()
    56	            if line:
    57	                try:
    58	                    rows.append(json.loads(line))
    59	                except ValueError:
    60	                    continue
    61	    return rows
    62	
    63	
    64	def mean(xs):
    65	    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
    66	    return sum(xs) / len(xs) if xs else None
    67	
    68	
    69	def fmt(x, nd=3):
    70	    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{x:.{nd}f}"
    71	
    72	
    73	def recall_details(row):
    74	    for g in row.get("graders") or []:
    75	        if g.get("name") == "recall-vs-defects.sh" and isinstance(g.get("details"), dict):
    76	            return g["details"]
    77	    return None
    78	
    79	
    80	def tokens(row):
    81	    u = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("usage") or {}
    82	    if not u:
    83	        return None
    84	    return sum(int(u.get(k, 0) or 0) for k in
    85	               ("input_tokens", "cache_creation_input_tokens", "cache_read_input_tokens", "output_tokens"))
    86	
    87	
    88	def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
    89	    if not sorted_xs:
    90	        return None
    91	    k = max(0, min(len(sorted_xs) - 1, int(round(q * (len(sorted_xs) - 1)))))
    92	    return sorted_xs[k]
    93	
    94	
    95	def bootstrap(deltas, iterations, level, seed):
    96	    """Percentile bootstrap of the mean of per-fixture deltas (resample fixtures)."""
    97	    if not deltas:
    98	        return None, None
    99	    rng = random.Random(seed)
   100	    n = len(deltas)
   101	    means = sorted(sum(deltas[rng.randrange(n)] for _ in range(n)) / n for _ in range(iterations))
   102	    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
   103	    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)
   104	
   105	
   106	class Arm:
   107	    def __init__(self, arm_id):
   108	        self.id = arm_id
   109	        self.cells = defaultdict(list)   # fixture -> [(trial, recall)], every completed trial kept
   110	        self.planted = {}                # fixture -> planted count
   111	        self.cited = 0
   112	        self.refuted = 0
   113	        self.tokens = []
   114	        self.models = set()
   115	        self.sources = set()
   116	        self.done = 0
   117	        self.errors = 0
   118	        self.fallback_trials = 0         # trials the CLI moved to another model on a safeguard refusal
   119	        self.fallback_kinds = Counter()
   120	        self.missed = Counter()          # (fixture, label) -> trials missed
   121	        self.seen = Counter()            # (fixture, label) -> trials graded
   122	
   123	    def add(self, row):
   124	        if row.get("status") != "completed":
   125	            self.errors += 1
   126	            return
   127	        d = recall_details(row)
   128	        if d is None:
   129	            self.errors += 1
   130	            return
   131	        self.done += 1
   132	        fx = row.get("fixture") or row.get("task_id", "").split("-", 1)[-1]
   133	        self.planted[fx] = int(d.get("planted") or 0)
   134	        if d.get("recall") is not None:
   135	            self.cells[fx].append((int(row.get("trial") or 0), float(d["recall"])))
   136	        if d.get("findings_cited") is not None:
   137	            self.cited += int(d.get("findings_cited") or 0)
   138	            self.refuted += int(d.get("findings_refuted") or 0)
   139	        t = tokens(row)
   140	        if t is not None:
   141	            self.tokens.append(t)
   142	        self.models.add(row.get("model_id") or (row.get("executor") or {}).get("model_id"))
   143	        # every model that produced output in the call (an auxiliary model is skew too)
   144	        for mid, out in ((row.get("executor") or {}).get("models_used") or {}).items():
   145	            if out:
   146	                self.models.add(mid)
   147	        fb = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("refusal_fallbacks") or []
   148	        if fb:
   149	            self.fallback_trials += 1
   150	            for x in fb:
   151	                self.fallback_kinds[f"{x.get('from')}→{x.get('to')} ({x.get('category')})"] += 1
   152	        self.sources.add(row.get("source_commit") or (row.get("executor") or {}).get("source_commit"))
   153	        for lbl in d.get("missed") or []:
   154	            self.missed[(fx, lbl)] += 1
   155	            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
   156	        for lbl in d.get("detected") or []:
   157	            self.seen[(fx, lbl)] += 1
   158	
   159	    def defect_fixtures(self):
   160	        return sorted(f for f, p in self.planted.items() if p > 0 and self.cells.get(f))
   161	
   162	    def fixture_means(self):
   163	        return {f: mean([r for _t, r in self.cells[f]]) for f in self.defect_fixtures()}
   164	
   165	    def trial_means(self):
   166	        by_trial = defaultdict(list)
   167	        for f in self.defect_fixtures():
   168	            for t, r in self.cells[f]:
   169	                by_trial[t].append(r)
   170	        return {t: mean(v) for t, v in sorted(by_trial.items())}
   171	
   172	    def refuted_share(self):
   173	        return self.refuted / self.cited if self.cited else None
   174	
   175	
   176	def suite_report(root, suites_dir, suite, partial, out_lines):
   177	    sdir = os.path.join(root, suite)
   178	    status = {}
   179	    sp = os.path.join(sdir, "STATUS.json")
   180	    if os.path.isfile(sp):
   181	        status = json.load(open(sp, encoding="utf-8"))
   182	    spec = load_yaml_subset(os.path.join(suites_dir, f"{suite}.yaml"))
   183	    ab = spec.get("ab") or {}
   184	    th = ab.get("threshold") or {}
   185	    arm_meta = {a["id"]: a for a in ab.get("arms") or []}
   186	    trials_required = int(th.get("trials_required", 3))
   187	    max_drop = float(th.get("mean_recall_max_drop", 0.10))
   188	    min_trial_drop = float(th.get("min_trial_recall_max_drop", 0.15))
   189	    refuted_rise = float(th.get("refuted_share_max_rise", 0.10))
   190	    bs = th.get("bootstrap") or {}
   191	    iterations = int(bs.get("iterations", 2000))
   192	    level = float(bs.get("level", 0.90))
   193	
   194	    planned_fx, planned_arms, manifests = set(), [], []
   195	    arms = {}
   196	    for batch in sorted(os.listdir(sdir)) if os.path.isdir(sdir) else []:
   197	        bdir = os.path.join(sdir, batch)
   198	        mp = os.path.join(bdir, "MANIFEST.json")
   199	        if not os.path.isfile(mp):
   200	            continue
   201	        m = json.load(open(mp, encoding="utf-8"))
   202	        if m.get("dry_run"):
   203	            continue
   204	        manifests.append(m)
   205	        planned_fx.update(m.get("fixtures") or [])
   206	        for a in m.get("arms") or []:
   207	            if a not in planned_arms:
   208	                planned_arms.append(a)
   209	            arm = arms.setdefault(a, Arm(a))
   210	            for row in read_jsonl(os.path.join(bdir, a, "results.jsonl")):
   211	                arm.add(row)
   212	    order = [a for a in arm_meta if a in arms] + [a for a in planned_arms if a not in arm_meta]
   213	    state = status.get("state", "unknown")
   214	    complete = state == "complete"
   215	
   216	    out_lines.append(f"## {suite}")
   217	    out_lines.append("")
   218	    out_lines.append(f"- STATUS: `{state}`; batches: {', '.join(b.get('batch', '?') for b in status.get('batches', [])) or 'none'}")
   219	    srcs = sorted({m.get('source_commit') for m in manifests})
   220	    models = sorted({m.get('model_id') for m in manifests})
   221	    out_lines.append(f"- source commit(s): {', '.join(f'`{s[:12]}`' for s in srcs if s) or 'n/a'}; executor model requested: {', '.join(f'`{x}`' for x in models if x) or 'n/a'}")
   222	    out_lines.append(f"- planned fixtures ({len(planned_fx)}): {', '.join(sorted(planned_fx)) or 'none'}")
   223	    out_lines.append(f"- threshold: trials_required {trials_required}, mean_recall_max_drop {max_drop}, "
   224	                     f"min_trial_recall_max_drop {min_trial_drop}, refuted_share_max_rise {refuted_rise}, "
   225	                     f"bootstrap {bs.get('method', 'percentile')} {level} over {bs.get('resample', 'fixtures')} x{iterations}")
   226	    out_lines.append("")
   227	
   228	    base = arms.get("baseline")
   229	    base_fm = base.fixture_means() if base else {}
   230	    base_tm = base.trial_means() if base else {}
   231	    base_spread = (max(base_tm.values()) - min(base_tm.values())) if base_tm else None
   232	    base_min = min(base_tm.values()) if base_tm else None
   233	    base_ref = base.refuted_share() if base else None
   234	
   235	    def coverage_gaps(arm):
   236	        gaps = []
   237	        for fx in sorted(planned_fx):
   238	            planted = arm.planted.get(fx)
   239	            n = len(arm.cells.get(fx, [])) if planted else 0
   240	            if planted == 0:
   241	                continue  # a clean fixture carries no recall; refuted share only
   242	            if n < trials_required:
   243	                gaps.append(f"{fx} {n}/{trials_required}")
   244	        return gaps
   245	
   246	    header = ("| arm | trials done | errors | mean recall | min | max | spread | drop vs baseline | "
   247	              f"{int(level * 100)}% CI of drop | refuted share | tokens/call | verdict |")
   248	    out_lines.append(header)
   249	    out_lines.append("|" + "---|" * 12)
   250	    details = []
   251	    verdicts = {}
   252	    for a in order:
   253	        arm = arms[a]
   254	        fm = arm.fixture_means()
   255	        tm = arm.trial_means()
   256	        m = mean(list(fm.values()))
   257	        mn = min(tm.values()) if tm else None
   258	        mx = max(tm.values()) if tm else None
   259	        spread = (mx - mn) if tm else None
   260	        rs = arm.refuted_share()
   261	        tok = mean(arm.tokens)
   262	        drop = lo = hi = None
   263	        reasons = []
   264	        if a == "baseline":
   265	            verdict = "(reference)"
   266	        else:
   267	            common = sorted(set(fm) & set(base_fm))
   268	            deltas = [base_fm[f] - fm[f] for f in common]
   269	            drop = mean(deltas)
   270	            lo, hi = bootstrap(deltas, iterations, level, f"{suite}:{a}")
   271	            if partial:
   272	                reasons.append("--partial report")
   273	            if not complete:
   274	                reasons.append(f"run state is {state}")
   275	            if base is None:
   276	                reasons.append("no baseline arm")
   277	            gaps = coverage_gaps(arm) + ([f"baseline {g}" for g in coverage_gaps(base)] if base else [])
   278	            if gaps:
   279	                reasons.append("coverage: " + ", ".join(gaps[:8]) + (" …" if len(gaps) > 8 else ""))
   280	            mods = {x for x in arm.models | (base.models if base else set()) if x}
   281	            if len(mods) > 1:
   282	                reasons.append("model skew: " + ", ".join(sorted(mods)))
   283	            srcs_a = {x for x in arm.sources | (base.sources if base else set()) if x}
   284	            if len(srcs_a) > 1:
   285	                reasons.append("source skew: " + ", ".join(sorted(s[:12] for s in srcs_a)))
   286	            if not deltas:
   287	                reasons.append("no defect fixture graded in both arms")
   288	            if reasons:
   289	                verdict = "inconclusive"
   290	            else:
   291	                violated, refuted_violated = [], False
   292	                if hi is None or hi > max_drop:
   293	                    violated.append(f"drop CI upper {fmt(hi)} > {max_drop}")
   294	                if mn is None or base_min is None or mn < base_min - min_trial_drop:
   295	                    violated.append(f"min trial {fmt(mn)} < baseline min {fmt(base_min)} - {min_trial_drop}")
   296	                if rs is not None and base_ref is not None and rs > base_ref + refuted_rise:
   297	                    violated.append(f"refuted share {fmt(rs)} > baseline {fmt(base_ref)} + {refuted_rise}")
   298	                    refuted_violated = True
   299	                if not violated:
   300	                    verdict = "no recall loss"
   301	                elif (not refuted_violated and drop is not None and base_spread is not None
   302	                      and abs(drop) <= base_spread):
   303	                    # only recall rules failed and the mean moved less than the
   304	                    # baseline moves against itself: too small a change to name
   305	                    verdict = "inconclusive"
   306	                    reasons.append("rule violated (" + "; ".join(violated) + f") but |drop| {fmt(abs(drop))} "
   307	                                   f"<= baseline spread {fmt(base_spread)}: no change can be named")
   308	                else:
   309	                    verdict = "recall loss"
   310	                    reasons.extend(violated)
   311	            if (arm_meta.get(a) or {}).get("informational"):
   312	                verdict += " (informational: yield only)"
   313	        verdicts[a] = verdict
   314	        out_lines.append(
   315	            f"| `{a}` | {arm.done} | {arm.errors} | {fmt(m)} | {fmt(mn)} | {fmt(mx)} | {fmt(spread)} | "
   316	            f"{fmt(drop)} | {('[' + fmt(lo) + ', ' + fmt(hi) + ']') if lo is not None else 'n/a'} | "
   317	            f"{fmt(rs)} | {('%.0f' % tok) if tok is not None else 'n/a'} | **{verdict}** |")
   318	        if arm.fallback_trials:
   319	            reasons.append(f"{arm.fallback_trials}/{arm.done} trial(s) fell back to another model on a safeguard refusal: "
   320	                           + ", ".join(f"{k} x{n}" for k, n in arm.fallback_kinds.most_common()))
   321	        if reasons:
   322	            details.append(f"- `{a}`: " + "; ".join(reasons))
   323	        if a != "baseline" and drop is not None and base_spread is not None:
   324	            named = "named" if abs(drop) > base_spread else "not named (within the baseline's own spread)"
   325	            details.append(f"- `{a}`: mean drop {fmt(drop)} vs baseline spread {fmt(base_spread)}: change {named}")
   326	    out_lines.append("")
   327	    if details:
   328	        out_lines.append("Verdict notes:")
   329	        out_lines.extend(details)
   330	        out_lines.append("")
   331	    out_lines.append("### Missed labels")
   332	    out_lines.append("")
   333	    for a in order:
   334	        arm = arms[a]
   335	        items = sorted(arm.missed.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))
   336	        if not items:
   337	            out_lines.append(f"- `{a}`: none")
   338	            continue
   339	        shown = ", ".join(f"{fx}:{lbl} ({n}/{arm.seen[(fx, lbl)]})" for (fx, lbl), n in items[:40])
   340	        more = f" … and {len(items) - 40} more" if len(items) > 40 else ""
   341	        out_lines.append(f"- `{a}`: {shown}{more}")
   342	    out_lines.append("")
   343	    return state, verdicts
   344	
   345	
   346	def main():
   347	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
   348	    ap.add_argument("--results-root", required=True)
   349	    ap.add_argument("--suites-dir", required=True)
   350	    ap.add_argument("--suites", default="")
   351	    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
   352	    ap.add_argument("--partial", action="store_true")
   353	    ap.add_argument("--date", default=datetime.date.today().isoformat())
   354	    args = ap.parse_args()
   355	
   356	    suites = [s for s in args.suites.split(",") if s] or sorted(
   357	        s for s in ("review-recall", "audit-recall") if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(args.results_root, s)))
   358	    if not suites:
   359	        print(f"arms-report: no suite results under {args.results_root}", file=sys.stderr)
   360	        return 2
   361	    for s in suites:
   362	        if not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(args.results_root, s)):
   363	            print(f"arms-report: no results for suite {s} under {args.results_root}", file=sys.stderr)
   364	            return 2
   365	        st = {}
   366	        sp = os.path.join(args.results_root, s, "STATUS.json")
   367	        if os.path.isfile(sp):
   368	            st = json.load(open(sp, encoding="utf-8"))
   369	        if st.get("state") != "complete" and not args.partial:
   370	            print(f"arms-report: {s} STATUS.json state is {st.get('state', 'missing')!r}, not 'complete'; "
   371	                  "refusing to write a verdict report (pass --partial for an inconclusive interim report)",
   372	                  file=sys.stderr)
   373	            return 1
   374	
   375	    lines = [f"# Control-arm report — {args.date}", ""]
   376	    if args.partial:
   377	        lines += ["> **PARTIAL REPORT.** Written with `--partial` before every run completed: every verdict "
   378	                  "below reads `inconclusive` and none licenses a deletion (SDD D-2.3).", ""]
   379	    lines += ["Generated by `evals/harness/report.sh --arms` from `" + args.results_root + "`. "
   380	              "Recall is graded by `recall-vs-defects.sh` (planted defects and approved record labels); "
   381	              "refuted share counts cited findings that match neither a label nor a fix region. "
   382	              "A deletion that relies on an arm requires the lead to read that arm's missed labels and record the reading.", ""]
   383	    for s in suites:
   384	        suite_report(args.results_root, args.suites_dir, s, args.partial, lines)
   385	    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(args.out)), exist_ok=True)
   386	    with open(args.out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
   387	        fh.write("\n".join(lines).rstrip() + "\n")
   388	    print(args.out)
   389	    return 0
   390	
   391	
   392	if __name__ == "__main__":
   393	    sys.exit(main())

Use yq/jq/python3 -I if available to parse (copy to a temp dir outside pr/ first).
- .claude/loa/reference/hooks-reference.md: the diff replaces a hooks table with a generated block between guard-register markers; check the table rows against the hook rows in guard-origins.yaml (ids, registrations, notes/purpose column) for mismatches; check the marker comment names match exactly what .claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh looks for (grep guard-yield.sh for 'guard-register').

- tests/unit/rule-paths.bats, tests/unit/guard-origins.bats, tests/unit/floor-snapshot.bats, tests/unit/loa-status-guards.bats, tests/unit/validate-artifact-sprint-kinds.bats, tests/unit/sprint-seams.bats, tests/unit/prompt-budget.bats, tests/fixtures/fence-corpus/run-corpus.sh: read each test and check its assertions against the actual head implementation files (guard-yield.sh, loa-status.sh, validate-artifact.sh, floor.yaml). 1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# execute-agent.sh — agent-execution step for Loa Eval Sandbox trials
     4	#
     5	# cycle-124 Sprint 3 (PRD FR-9 / SDD §3.6). Fills the slot at the top of the
     6	# grading step in run-eval.sh: a task that declares `.agent.skill` runs the
     7	# headless Claude CLI inside the sandbox before its graders; every other task
     8	# takes the pre-existing path untouched.
     9	#
    10	# What it does, in order:
    11	#   1. Gate: no `.agent.skill` in the task YAML → exit 3, nothing written.
    12	#   2. Materialize the prompt surface from $EVAL_PROMPT_TREE into the sandbox:
    13	#        <ws>/.claude/skills/<skill>/        (SKILL.md + resources/)
    14	#        <ws>/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md      (+ .claude/rules/)
    15	#        <ws>/CLAUDE.md                      → "@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
    16	#        <ws>/.eval/skill-prompt.md          (SKILL.md body, frontmatter stripped)
    17	#      The prompt tree is the ONLY thing that differs between A/B arms, so it
    18	#      is recorded: prompt_tree_sha = `git rev-parse HEAD:.claude` of the tree,
    19	#      prompt_tree_commit, and whether .claude/ had uncommitted changes.
    20	#   3. Run:  claude -p "<task.prompt>" --output-format stream-json --verbose
    21	#              --model $EVAL_MODEL [--effort <e>] --restricted --tools Read,Grep,Glob,Write
    22	#              --permission-mode acceptEdits --append-system-prompt-file <skill-prompt>
    23	#              --max-turns $EVAL_MAX_TURNS
    24	#      --restricted --tools names the SDD's fixed tool set EXACTLY: it removes the
    25	#      code-running tools, ignores the operator's user/project/local settings (their
    26	#      Bash(...) allow rules leaked into the sprint-237 A/B arms under --allowed-tools,
    27	#      which only adds rules) and confines Read/Grep/Glob/Write to the sandbox.
    28	#      Edit/MultiEdit are therefore unavailable; the transcript extractor below still
    29	#      records them defensively.
    30	#      cwd = sandbox; env-isolated (LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH / LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH and
    31	#      TMPDIR into the sandbox; GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN/OPENAI_API_KEY/AWS_* unset;
    32	#      HOME and PATH stay so the CLI finds its own credentials and toolchain).
    33	#   4. Record <ws>/.eval/events.jsonl (raw stream), agent-output.json (the
    34	#      `result` event) and executor.json:
    35	#        {schema_version, skill, model_requested, model_id (the id the CLI
    36	#         echoed — the modelUsage entry with the most output tokens), effort,
    37	#         prompt_tree_sha, prompt_tree_commit, prompt_tree_dirty, exit_code,
    38	#         is_error, duration_ms, num_turns, total_cost_usd, usage{…},
    39	#         tool_writes:[{seq,tool,path}] in transcript order}

    42	#   0  agent ran (its own verdict is the graders' business)

    46	#

    49	#   EVAL_EFFORT         override effort                    (default: task/skill)

    52	#   EVAL_MAX_TURNS      --max-turns                        (default 40)

1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# evals/tests/arms-report.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 1 Task 1.4 (FR-2, SDD D-2.3)
     4	#
     5	# report.sh --arms over a fixture results tree (the layout run-arms.sh
     6	# writes): the pre-registered verdicts, the bootstrap interval, refuted share,
     7	# missed labels, the refusal while STATUS.json is not complete and the
     8	# --partial header. Thresholds come from the real review-recall suite.
     9	# =============================================================================
    10	
    11	setup() {
    12	  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
    13	  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    14	  REPORT="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/report.sh"
    15	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ar.XXXXXX")"
    16	  R="$T/arms"; S="$R/review-recall"; B="$S/b1"
    17	  mkdir -p "$B"
    18	  jq -n '{schema_version:1, suite:"review-recall", batch:"b1", dry_run:false, source_commit:"864069f2f31c57dd00cd4e29e862d6c16d17c457",
    19	          model_id:"claude-fable-5-1", arms:["baseline","no_companion","no_karpathy","no_rule_files"], fixtures:["pr-01","pr-02","pr-03"], trials:3}' \
    20	    > "$B/MANIFEST.json"
    21	  status_file complete
    22	}
    23	
    24	teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }
    25	
    26	status_file() {  # status_file <state>
    27	  jq -n --arg s "$1" '{schema_version:1, suite:"review-recall", state:$s, batches:[{batch:"b1", state:$s}],
    28	                       source_commit:"864069f2f31c57dd00cd4e29e862d6c16d17c457", model_id:"claude-fable-5-1"}' > "$S/STATUS.json"
    29	}
    30	
    31	# row <arm> <fixture> <trial> <recall> <missed-csv> [<cited> <refuted> <model> <source>]
    32	row() {
    33	  local arm="$1" fx="$2" t="$3" rc="$4" missed="$5" cited="${6:-4}" ref="${7:-1}"
    34	  local model="${8:-claude-fable-5-1}" src="${9:-864069f2f31c57dd00cd4e29e862d6c16d17c457}"
    35	  mkdir -p "$B/$arm"
    36	  jq -cn --arg arm "$arm" --arg fx "$fx" --argjson t "$t" --argjson rc "$rc" --arg missed "$missed" \
    37	    --argjson cited "$cited" --argjson ref "$ref" --arg model "$model" --arg src "$src" \
    38	    '{status:"completed", arm:$arm, fixture:$fx, task_id:("review-" + $fx), trial:$t, model_id:$model, source_commit:$src,
    39	      executor:{model_id:$model, usage:{input_tokens:100, cache_read_input_tokens:900, output_tokens:0, cache_creation_input_tokens:0}},
    40	      graders:[{name:"recall-vs-defects.sh", details:{recall:$rc, planted:3,
    41	        detected:[], missed:($missed | split(",") | map(select(length > 0))),
    42	        findings_cited:$cited, findings_refuted:$ref}}]}' >> "$B/$arm/results.jsonl"
    43	}
    44	
    45	full_arm() {  # full_arm <arm> <recall> [<missed>] [<refuted>]
    46	  local fx t
    47	  for fx in pr-01 pr-02 pr-03; do for t in 1 2 3; do row "$1" "$fx" "$t" "$2" "${3:-}" 4 "${4:-1}"; done; done
    48	}
    49	
    50	@test "AR-1 complete run: equal recall reads no recall loss, a large drop reads recall loss, the informational arm says so" {
    51	  full_arm baseline 1
    52	  full_arm no_rule_files 1
    53	  full_arm no_karpathy 0.3333 "L2,L3" 1
    54	  full_arm no_companion 1
    55	  run "$REPORT" --arms --suite review-recall --results-dir "$R" --out "$T/r.md" --date 2026-10-14
    56	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    57	  grep -E '^\| `no_rule_files` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '\*\*no recall loss\*\*'
    58	  grep -E '^\| `no_karpathy` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '\*\*recall loss\*\*'
    59	  grep -E '^\| `no_companion` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q 'informational: yield only'
    60	  grep -E '^\| `baseline` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '(reference)'
    61	  # the interval of the drop and the missed labels are printed
    62	  grep -E '^\| `no_karpathy` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '\[0.667, 0.667\]'
    63	  grep -q 'no_karpathy`: pr-01:L2 (3/3)' "$T/r.md"
    64	  grep -q '^# Control-arm report — 2026-10-14' "$T/r.md"
    65	  ! grep -q 'PARTIAL REPORT' "$T/r.md"
    66	}
    67	
    68	@test "AR-2 a refuted-share rise beyond the threshold is a recall loss even with equal recall" {
    69	  full_arm baseline 1 "" 0
    70	  full_arm no_rule_files 1 "" 3
    71	  run "$REPORT" --arms --suite review-recall --results-dir "$R" --out "$T/r.md"
    72	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    73	  grep -E '^\| `no_rule_files` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '\*\*recall loss\*\*'
    74	  grep -q 'refuted share 0.750 > baseline 0.000' "$T/r.md"
    75	}
    76	
    77	@test "AR-3 a missing trial or fixture is inconclusive; model or source skew is inconclusive" {
    78	  full_arm baseline 1

     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# claude-stub.sh — stand-in for the `claude` CLI used by evals/tests/*.bats.
     3	# Records argv + selected env, optionally writes files into the cwd, and
     4	# emits a canned stream-json transcript so execute-agent.sh can be tested
     5	# without a model call.
     6	#
     7	#   STUB_ARGV_FILE   where "$@" is written (one arg per line)
     8	#   STUB_ENV_FILE    where selected env vars are written (KEY=VALUE)
     9	#   STUB_EVENTS_FILE stream-json lines to emit (default: a 2-write transcript)
    10	#   STUB_WRITE_<n>   "relative/path::content" files to create in the cwd
    11	#   STUB_EXIT        exit code (default 0)
    12	#   STUB_SNAPSHOT_DIR  copy the cwd's CLAUDE.md, .claude/, .loa.config.yaml and
    13	#                    the --append-system-prompt-file there at start: the
    14	#                    sandbox exactly as the executor sees it (arm-toggles.bats)
    15	#   STUB_FAIL_COUNTER  a file holding N: while N > 0, decrement it and exit 1
    16	#                    with no result event (a transport failure; run-arms.bats)
    17	set -euo pipefail
    18	
    19	# `--version` (run-arms.sh records it in MANIFEST.json) has no side effects
    20	if [[ "${1:-}" == "--version" ]]; then echo "0.0.0 (claude-stub)"; exit 0; fi
    21	
    22	if [[ -n "${STUB_FAIL_COUNTER:-}" && -f "$STUB_FAIL_COUNTER" ]]; then
    23	  n="$(cat "$STUB_FAIL_COUNTER")"
    24	  if [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]]; then
    25	    echo $((n - 1)) > "$STUB_FAIL_COUNTER"
    26	    echo "stub: simulated transport failure (socket hang up)" >&2
    27	    exit 1
    28	  fi
    29	fi
    30	
    31	if [[ -n "${STUB_SNAPSHOT_DIR:-}" ]]; then
    32	  mkdir -p "$STUB_SNAPSHOT_DIR"
    33	  for p in CLAUDE.md .claude .loa.config.yaml; do
    34	    [[ -e "$p" ]] && cp -a "$p" "$STUB_SNAPSHOT_DIR/"
    35	  done
    36	  prev=""
    37	  for a in "$@"; do
    38	    [[ "$prev" == "--append-system-prompt-file" ]] && cp "$a" "$STUB_SNAPSHOT_DIR/system-prompt.md"
    39	    prev="$a"
    40	  done
    41	fi
    42	
    43	if [[ -n "${STUB_ARGV_FILE:-}" ]]; then
    44	  printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$STUB_ARGV_FILE"
    45	fi
    46	if [[ -n "${STUB_ENV_FILE:-}" ]]; then
    47	  {
    48	    printf 'PWD=%s\n' "$PWD"
    49	    for k in LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH HOME EVAL_MODEL TMPDIR GH_TOKEN GITHUB_TOKEN OPENAI_API_KEY AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY \
    50	             CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS; do
    51	      printf '%s=%s\n' "$k" "${!k:-}"
    52	    done
    53	  } > "$STUB_ENV_FILE"
    54	fi
    55	
    56	for var in "${!STUB_WRITE_@}"; do
    57	  spec="${!var}"
    58	  rel="${spec%%::*}"
    59	  body="${spec#*::}"
    60	  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$rel")"
    61	  printf '%b' "$body" > "$rel"
    62	done
    63	
    64	if [[ -n "${STUB_EVENTS_FILE:-}" && -f "${STUB_EVENTS_FILE}" ]]; then
    65	  cat "$STUB_EVENTS_FILE"
    66	else
    67	  cat <<'EVENTS'
    68	{"type":"system","subtype":"init","model":"claude-sonnet-5"}
    69	{"type":"assistant","message":{"content":[{"type":"tool_use","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"tests/test_x.py","content":"def test_x(): assert False"}}]}}
    70	{"type":"assistant","message":{"content":[{"type":"tool_use","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"src/x.py","content":"X = 1"}}]}}
    71	{"type":"result","subtype":"success","is_error":false,"duration_ms":1234,"num_turns":3,"result":"done","total_cost_usd":0.0123,"usage":{"input_tokens":100,"output_tokens":42,"cache_creation_input_tokens":5,"cache_read_input_tokens":7},"modelUsage":{"claude-sonnet-5-20260401":{"inputTokens":100,"outputTokens":42,"cacheReadInputTokens":7,"cacheCreationInputTokens":5,"costUSD":0.0123}}}
    72	EVENTS
    73	fi
    74	
    75	exit "${STUB_EXIT:-0}"

  }
  /^[[:space:]]*#/ { next }
  {
    line = $0
    if (line ~ /emit_block[[:space:]]*\(\)/) next
    while (match(line, /emit_block[[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+/)) {

  | ($e.hooks | map(.id)) as $hooks | $e.fences as $fences | $e.validators as $validators
  | (($hooks + $fences + $validators)[] | select($by[.] == null) | "guard \(.) has no origin row in \($map)"),
    ($g[] | select(.kind == "hook") | select(.id | IN($hooks[]) | not) | "row \(.id) resolves to nothing: no command in .claude/settings.json runs that script"),
    ($g[] | select(.kind == "fence") | select(.id | IN($fences[]) | not) | "row \(.id) resolves to nothing: no # @guard fence marker with that id in the fence"),
    ($g[] | select(.kind == "validator") | select(.id | IN($validators[]) | not) | "row \(.id) resolves to nothing: no # @guard validator marker with that id in validate-artifact.sh"),
    ($e.hooks[] | . as $h | $by[$h.id] // empty | select(((.registrations // []) | unique) != $h.registrations)
      | "row \($h.id) registrations \((.registrations // []) | unique | tojson) differ from .claude/settings.json \($h.registrations | tojson)"),
    (($gates + $policies)[] | select($by[.] == null) | "required row \(.) is missing from \($map)"),
    ((($floor.floor_guards // []) | if type != "array" then ["(floor_guards is not a list)"] else . end) as $fg
      | ($fg[] | select($by[.] == null) | "floor guard \(.) has no row in \($map)"),
        ($g[] | select(.floor == true) | select(.id | IN($fg[]) | not) | "row \(.id) has floor: true but is not in floor.yaml floor_guards"),
        ($g[] | select(.floor != true) | select(.id | IN($fg[])) | "row \(.id) is in floor.yaml floor_guards but has floor: false"))
' <<<"$MAP_JSON" >> "$ERRORS"

while IFS= read -r spath; do
    [[ -n "$spath" ]] || continue
    case "$spath" in /*|*..*) echo "gate or policy script '$spath' must be a repository-relative path" >> "$ERRORS"; continue ;; esac
    [[ -f "$ROOT/$spath" ]] || echo "gate or policy script $spath does not exist" >> "$ERRORS"
done < <(jq -r '.guards[] | select(.kind == "gate" or .kind == "policy") | .script' <<<"$MAP_JSON")

if [[ -s "$ERRORS" ]]; then
    sed "s/^/$SCRIPT_NAME: /" "$ERRORS" >&2
    exit 5
fi

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- renderers
# Shared cell sanitiser: control characters removed, pipes escaped for GFM tables.
JQ_DEFS='
  def cell: tostring | explode | map(select(. >= 32 and . != 127)) | implode | gsub("\\|"; "\\|");
  def kinds: ["hook", "fence", "validator", "gate", "policy"];
  def regs: if (.registrations // []) | length == 0 then "-" else (.registrations | map("`" + cell + "`") | join(", ")) end;
  def origin_txt: .origin as $o | if ($o.ref | tostring | startswith($o.kind | tostring)) then ($o.ref | tostring) else "\($o.kind) \($o.ref)" end;
  def yesno: if . == true then "yes" else "no" end;
'

render_register() {
    jq -r "$JQ_DEFS"'
      .guards as $g
      | "# Guard register",
        "",
        "<!-- Generated by .claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh from .claude/settings.json, the fence and validator markers and .claude/data/guard-origins.yaml. Do not edit by hand: edit the origin map and regenerate (.claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh --hooks-table); CI runs --check. -->",
        "",
        "Every guard Loa ships, with its class, status, origin, knob and floor flag. Structural only: the 30-day yield of a host is untracked, in `.run/guard-yield.md` and `.run/guard-yield.json` (regenerate with `.claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh`). Classes: harness (the model cannot override it), script (a script checks or reports), prose (the model is asked to comply). Status: dormant means armed only by the env var in the knob column; telemetry means it observes and never refuses.",
        "",
        "- guards: \($g | length)",
        "- guards_without_origin: \($g | map(select((.origin.ref // "") == "")) | length)",
        "- dormant: \($g | map(select(.status == "dormant")) | length)",
        "- floor: \($g | map(select(.floor == true)) | length)",
        (kinds[] as $k | ($g | map(select(.kind == $k))) as $rows | select($rows | length > 0)
          | "",
            "## \($k) (\($rows | length))",
            "",
            "| id | class | status | origin | knob | floor | registrations |",
            "|----|-------|--------|--------|------|-------|---------------|",
            ($rows[] | "| \(.id | cell) | \(.class | cell) | \(.status | cell) | \(origin_txt | cell) | \(.knob | cell) | \(.floor | yesno) | \(regs) |"))
    ' <<<"$MAP_JSON"
}

render_hooks_block() {
    jq -r --argjson hooks "$HOOKS_JSON" "$JQ_DEFS"'
      (.guards | map({key: .id, value: .}) | from_entries) as $by
      | "<!-- guard-register:begin -->",
        "<!-- Generated by .claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh --hooks-table from .claude/settings.json and .claude/data/guard-origins.yaml; do not edit by hand. Full register: grimoires/loa/guards.md -->",
        "| Event | Matcher | Script | Status | Knob | Purpose |",
        "|-------|---------|--------|--------|------|---------|",
        ($hooks[] | . as $h | $by[$h.id] as $r
          | "| \($h.event | cell) | \(if $h.matcher == "" then "(all)" else ($h.matcher | cell) end) | `\(if $h.wrapped then "hook-guard.sh " else "" end)\($h.id | ltrimstr("hook:") | cell)` | \($r.status | cell) | \($r.knob | cell) | \($r.note // "" | cell) |"),
        "<!-- guard-register:end -->"
    ' <<<"$MAP_JSON"
}

# Rewrites the marker block of $HOOKS_REF into $2 (exit 3 when the markers are absent or repeated).
render_hooks_ref() {
    local block="$1" dest="$2" nb ne
    [[ -f "$HOOKS_REF" && -r "$HOOKS_REF" ]] || die 3 "hooks reference not readable: $HOOKS_REF"
    nb="$(grep -c '^<!-- guard-register:begin -->$' "$HOOKS_REF" || true)"
    ne="$(grep -c '^<!-- guard-register:end -->$' "$HOOKS_REF" || true)"
    [[ "$nb" == "1" && "$ne" == "1" ]] \
        || die 3 "$HOOKS_REF needs exactly one <!-- guard-register:begin --> and one <!-- guard-register:end --> line (found $nb and $ne)"
    awk -v blockfile="$block" '
      /^<!-- guard-register:begin -->$/ { while ((getline l < blockfile) > 0) print l; skip = 1; next }
      /^<!-- guard-register:end -->$/ { skip = 0; next }
      !skip { print }
    ' "$HOOKS_REF" > "$dest"
}

# Atomic replace: temp beside the destination, then rename.
install_file() {
    local src="$1" dest="$2" tmp
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$dest")"
    tmp="$(mktemp "$(dirname "$dest")/.$(basename "$dest").XXXXXX")"
    cat "$src" > "$tmp"
    chmod 0644 "$tmp"
    mv -f "$tmp" "$dest"
}

REGISTER_NEW="$TMPWORK/guards.md"
render_register > "$REGISTER_NEW"
HOOKS_BLOCK="$TMPWORK/hooks-block.md"
render_hooks_block > "$HOOKS_BLOCK"
HOOKS_REF_NEW="$TMPWORK/hooks-reference.md"
N_GUARDS="$(jq '.guards | length' <<<"$MAP_JSON")"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- --check
if (( DO_CHECK )); then
    render_hooks_ref "$HOOKS_BLOCK" "$HOOKS_REF_NEW"

A block is a likely false 35 # positive (a heuristic) when its command holds a heredoc (`<<`; or, when 36 # .claude/scripts/lib/heredoc-classifier.sh defines heredoc_nonexec, a heredoc 37 # that function calls non-executing), when its cwd lies outside the repository 38 # (this checkout and its main worktree), or when its pattern id is a prose class 39 # (SP-1, FR-MERGE-2, FR-2-AMBIGUOUS) with no destructive verb at statement start. 40 # A real catch is a block that is not a likely false positive. 41 # 42 # Privacy: no command text, cwd, hostname, user or model name is written to any 43 # output;       | if ($g.id | IN($writers[])) then
          ($cls | map(select(any(.ids[]; . == $g.id)))) as $mine
          | ($mine | map(select(.block and (.fp | not))) | map(.t) | max) as $last
          | {id, kind, class, status, origin: origin_txt, knob, floor, registrations: (.registrations // []), audited: true,
             blocks_30d: ($mine | map(select(.block)) | length),
             likely_fp_30d: ($mine | map(select(.fp)) | length),
             telemetry_30d: ($mine | map(select(.telemetry)) | length),
             last_real_catch: (if $last == null then "none in window" else ($last | day) end)}
        else
          {id, kind, class, status, origin: origin_txt, knob, floor, registrations: (.registrations // []), audited: false,
           blocks_30d: null, likely_fp_30d: null, telemetry_30d: null, last_real_catch: "n/a"}
        end)) as $guards
  | {
      schema_version: 1,
      generated_at: ($now | day),
      window_days: $win,
      scope: "host",
      audit_segments: $segs,
      audit_rows_read: $read,
      audit_rows_unparseable: (($raw | length) - $read),
      audit_rows_considered: ($inwin | length),
      replay_rows_excluded: (($inwin | length) - ($live | length)),
      replay_rows_by_rule: {
        flag: ($inwin | map(select(.replay == true)) | length),
        cwd: ($inwin | map(select(.replay != true and replay([]))) | length),
        burst: ($inwin | map(select(.replay != true and (replay([]) | not) and replay($burst))) | length)
      },
      heuristic: "likely_fp = heredoc in the command OR cwd outside the repository OR (pattern SP-1, FR-MERGE-2 or FR-2-AMBIGUOUS with no destructive verb at statement start); real = block AND NOT likely_fp",
      totals: {
        guards: ($map.guards | length),
        guards_without_origin: 0,
        dormant: ($map.guards | map(select(.status == "dormant")) | length),
        blocks_30d: ($cls | map(select(.block)) | length),
        real_blocks_30d: ($cls | map(select(.block and (.fp | not))) | length),
        likely_fp_30d: ($cls | map(select(.fp)) | length),
        telemetry_30d: ($cls | map(select(.telemetry)) | length),
        unattributed_30d: ($cls | map(select(.ids | length == 0)) | length)
      },
      guards: $guards
    }
' "$ROWS")" || die 3 "the audit log could not be joined"

render_yield_md() {
    jq -r "$JQ_DEFS"'
      def n: if . == null then "n/a" else tostring end;
      . as $y
      | "# Guard yield (host)",
        "",
        "<!-- Generated by .claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh; untracked, host-local. The structural register is grimoires/loa/guards.md. -->",
        "",
        "- generated_at: \($y.generated_at)",
        "- window_days: \($y.window_days)",
        "- scope: \($y.scope)",
        "- audit_segments: \($y.audit_segments)",
        "- audit_rows_considered: \($y.audit_rows_considered)",
        "- replay_rows_excluded: \($y.replay_rows_excluded) (flag \($y.replay_rows_by_rule.flag), cwd \($y.replay_rows_by_rule.cwd), burst \($y.replay_rows_by_rule.burst))",
        "- audit_rows_unparseable: \($y.audit_rows_unparseable)",
        "- totals: \($y.totals.real_blocks_30d) real blocks, \($y.totals.likely_fp_30d) likely FP, \($y.totals.telemetry_30d) telemetry, \($y.totals.unattributed_30d) unattributed",
        "- heuristic: \($y.heuristic | cell)",
        (kinds[] as $k | ($y.guards | map(select(.kind == $k))) as $rows | select($rows | length > 0)
          | "",
            "## \($k) (\($rows | length))",
            "",
            "| id | class | status | origin | knob | floor | registrations | blocks_30d | likely_fp_30d | telemetry_30d | last_real_catch |",
            "|----|-------|--------|--------|------|-------|---------------|------------|---------------|---------------|-----------------|",
            ($rows[] | "| \(.id | cell) | \(.class | cell) | \(.status | cell) | \(.origin | cell) | \(.knob | cell) | \(.floor | yesno) | \(regs) | \(.blocks_30d | n) | \(.likely_fp_30d | n) | \(.telemetry_30d | n) | \(.last_real_catch | cell) |"))
    ' <<<"$YIELD_JSON"
}

YIELD_MD_NEW="$TMPWORK/guard-yield.md"
YIELD_JSON_NEW="$TMPWORK/guard-yield.json"
render_yield_md > "$YIELD_MD_NEW"
jq '.' <<<"$YIELD_JSON" > "$YIELD_JSON_NEW"

install_file "$REGISTER_NEW" "$OUT"
install_file "$YIELD_MD_NEW" "$YIELD_DIR/guard-yield.md"
install_file "$YIELD_JSON_NEW" "$YIELD_DIR/guard-yield.json"
if (( DO_HOOKS_TABLE )); then
    render_hooks_ref "$HOOKS_BLOCK" "$HOOKS_REF_NEW"
    cmp -s "$HOOKS_REF_NEW" "$HOOKS_REF" || install_file "$HOOKS_REF_NEW" "$HOOKS_REF"
fi

summary="$(jq -r '"\(.totals.guards) guards (\(.totals.dormant) dormant); \(.window_days) d: \(.totals.real_blocks_30d) real blocks, \(.totals.likely_fp_30d) likely FP, \(.replay_rows_excluded) replay rows excluded; scope host"' <<<"$YIELD_JSON")"
if (( DO_JSON )); then
    cat "$YIELD_JSON_NEW"
    echo "$SCRIPT_NAME: wrote $OUT and $YIELD_DIR/guard-yield.{md,json}: $summary" >&2
else
    echo "$SCRIPT_NAME: wrote $OUT and $YIELD_DIR/guard-yield.{md,json}: $summary"
fi
exit 0

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# recall-vs-defects.sh — deterministic planted-defect recall grader
     4	#
     5	# cycle-124 Sprint 3 (PRD FR-9). Args: $1=workspace, $2=fixture id (pr-NN),
     6	# $3=review file (default review.md). Reads the HIDDEN manifest
     7	# evals/fixtures/review-prs/manifests/<id>.json (never copied into the
     8	# sandbox) and the agent's review.
     9	#
    10	# Rule (PRD FR-9 A/B protocol, no fuzzy adjudication): a defect is DETECTED
    11	# when the review contains a `path:line` (or `path:line-line`) citation whose
    12	# path ends with the defect's file (repo-relative, `head/`-prefixed, or the
    13	# bare basename) and whose line, or line range, falls within ±3 of the
    14	# manifest anchor — `anchor_line`, or any line in `anchors[]` for a defect
    15	# with more than one site.
    16	#
    17	# Parser (1.1.0, bd-ewrc): a leading `(` is not part of the path; comma
    18	# continuations (`path:776,807`, `path:10, 118-121`) and a later bare `:N` or
    19	# `head:N` / `base:N` bind to the most recent cited path. A `:N` glued to a
    20	# word or a number (`note:40`, `10:40`), or with no cited path before it,
    21	# credits nothing.
    22	#
    23	# Parser 1.1.1 (sprint-250 review run 1, n40-n42): the LOA-VERDICT trailer is
    24	# removed before citations are parsed, and a bare `:N` after a quote, bracket,
    25	# brace or `*` (JSON such as `"high":3`) credits nothing; a backtick- or
    26	# bold-wrapped path (`` `b.sh`:40 ``, `**b.sh**:40`) binds its own line; a comma
    27	# continuation or range stays on its line, and a continuation must end at a
    28	# number boundary (no dates);
    29	# a path containing `//` (a URL) is not a citation.
    30	# Run 2 (#11/#13-#15): a match inside any URL token (`scheme://...`) is not a
    31	# citation; a range dash is unspaced and every number (first, continuation,
    32	# bare) ends at a boundary (no further `-N` / `–N`: no dates); the
    33	# quote/bracket guard applies only to the fully bare `:N` (plus a closing
    34	# backtick), so `"head:40"` binds as in 1.1.0; one trailer pattern strips and
    35	# reads the LOA-VERDICT comment and never crosses another comment's bounds.
    36	# Parser 1.1.2 (the run 2 changes above, plus sprint-250 review run 3): the
    37	# URL look-back takes the text after the last whitespace — one linear split —
    38	# so a citation that opens a line never inherits the previous line's URL.
    39	# The parser runs as `python3 -I -` (audit dissent run 1, n32): a module planted
    40	# in the invoker's cwd (a forging json.py) is never imported (RG-27).
    41	#
    42	# Grader 1.2.0 (cycle-129 FR-2, SDD D-2.3): adds the refuted-share figure;
    43	# the recall rule and the pass/score contract are unchanged. A FINDING is one
    44	# distinct cited (path, line-range); it is MATCHED when it overlaps (±3) a
    45	# defect site or a manifest `fix_regions[]` entry ({file, start, end}: the
    46	# head-side lines a record fixture's fix commit touched). details gain
    47	# findings_cited, findings_refuted and refuted_share (refuted / cited; null
    48	# when nothing is cited).
    49	#
    50	# Clean fixtures (0 planted defects) measure FALSE POSITIVES: the LOA-VERDICT
    51	# trailer's critical+high counts; without a trailer, every file:line citation
    52	# counts as one.
    53	#
    54	# Output: {"pass", "score", "details":{recall, planted, detected[], missed[],
    55	#          false_positives, severity_counts, model, effort, tokens}, "grader_version"}
    56	#   pass  = every planted defect detected (defect fixture) / zero false
    57	#           positives (clean fixture); score = recall*100 or 100/0.
    58	# Exit: 0 pass, 1 fail, 2 error (missing manifest / bad args)
    59	#
    60	# Tested by evals/tests/eval-recall-grader.bats.
    61	# =============================================================================
    62	set -euo pipefail
    63	
    64	workspace="${1:-}"
    65	fixture="${2:-}"
    66	review_name="${3:-review.md}"
    67	
    68	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    69	MANIFEST_DIR="${EVAL_MANIFEST_DIR:-$SCRIPT_DIR/../fixtures/review-prs/manifests}"
    70	
    71	err() { printf '{"pass":false,"score":0,"details":{"error":%s},"grader_version":"1.2.0"}\n' "$(jq -Rn --arg m "$1" '$m')"; exit 2; }
    72	
    73	[[ -n "$workspace" && -d "$workspace" ]] || err "invalid workspace"
    74	[[ -n "$fixture" && "$fixture" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ ]] || err "invalid fixture id"
    75	manifest="$MANIFEST_DIR/$fixture.json"
    76	[[ -f "$manifest" ]] || err "manifest not found: $manifest"
    77	case "$review_name" in */*|..*) err "review file must be a bare name" ;; esac
    78	
    79	review="$workspace/$review_name"
    80	executor="$workspace/.eval/executor.json"
    81	
    82	if [[ ! -f "$review" ]]; then
    83	  printf '{"pass":false,"score":0,"details":{"error":"review file not found: %s","planted":%s,"detected":[],"recall":0},"grader_version":"1.2.0"}\n' \
    84	    "$review_name" "$(jq '.defects | length' "$manifest")"
    85	  exit 1
    86	fi
    87	
    88	python3 -I - "$manifest" "$review" "$executor" <<'PY'
    89	import json, re, sys
    90	manifest_path, review_path, executor_path = sys.argv[1:4]
    91	man = json.load(open(manifest_path))
    92	text = open(review_path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
    93	
    94	# path:line[-line] citations. Path = something with a file extension; the
    95	# optional trailing range keeps `file.py:10-14` in one token, and the comma
    96	# list after it (`:776,807`) belongs to the same path. A bare `:N` (or
    97	# `head:N` / `base:N`) not glued to a word binds to the most recent path.
    98	# a range dash is unspaced (`a.sh:12 - 40 rows` is prose, not a range) and
    99	# every number ends at a boundary: no letter or digit, and no hyphen / en dash
   100	# before another digit, after it (dates such as 2026-10-05 / 2026–10–05 never
   101	# parse; an open `:369-...` still cites 369) — sprint-250 review run 2, #13
   102	RNG = r'(\d{1,6})(?:[-–](\d{1,6}))?(?![A-Za-z0-9]|[-–]\d)'
   103	CITE = re.compile(
   104	    r'(?P<path>[A-Za-z0-9_./+()-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9]{1,6})[`*)]{0,3}:(?P<first>' + RNG
   105	    + r'(?:[ \t]*,[ \t]*' + RNG + r')*)'
   106	    # head:N / base:N keep the 1.1.0 boundary set ("head:40" binds); the JSON
   107	    # punctuation set, plus a CLOSING backtick (one after a token character:
   108	    # `rows`:40, `"high"`:3), guards only the fully bare :N — an opening
   109	    # backtick (`:7`, (`:212`)) still binds (RG-13) — run 2, #14
   110	    r'|(?:(?<![A-Za-z0-9_./:])(?:head|base)|(?<![A-Za-z0-9_./:"\'{}\[\]*])(?<![A-Za-z0-9_"\'}\]]`)):(?P<bare>' + RNG + r')')
   111	ONE = re.compile(RNG)
   112	cites = []
   113	last = None
   114	# the trailer is machine output (its counts are read below), never a citation.
   115	# One pattern strips and reads it (tolerant whitespace, line breaks); the body
   116	# may not contain another comment's `<!--` or `-->`, so an unterminated
   117	# `<!-- LOA-VERDICT` strips nothing — sprint-250 review run 2, #15
   118	TRAILER = re.compile(r'<!--\s*LOA-VERDICT\s*(\{(?:(?!<!--|-->).)*\})\s*-->', re.S)
   119	body = TRAILER.sub('', text)
   120	URL = re.compile(r'[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*://|^//')
   121	for m in CITE.finditer(body):
   122	    if m.group("path") is not None:
   123	        # a URL (https://h/x.js:8080, //host.com:8080) is not a path, nor is a
   124	        # partial match that starts later inside the URL token
   125	        # (https://u@h.com/x.js:8080 matches `h.com/x.js`) — run 2, #11
   126	        # the token so far is the window's text after its last whitespace —
   127	        # one linear split ("" when the window ends in whitespace); `\S*$`
   128	        # also matched before a final newline, so a line-leading citation
   129	        # inherited the previous line's URL, and was O(k^2) — run 3
   130	        tok = re.split(r'\s', body[max(0, m.start() - 4096):m.start()])[-1] + m.group("path")
   131	        if "//" in m.group("path") or URL.search(tok):
   132	            continue
   133	        p = m.group("path").lstrip("(")
   134	        if p.startswith("./"):
   135	            p = p[2:]
   136	        last, spans = p, m.group("first")
   137	    elif last is not None:
   138	        p, spans = last, m.group("bare")
   139	    else:
   140	        continue
   141	    for r in ONE.finditer(spans):
   142	        a = int(r.group(1)); b = int(r.group(2)) if r.group(2) else a
   143	        if b < a:
   144	            a, b = b, a
   145	        cites.append((p, a, b))
   146	
   147	def path_matches(cited, defect_file):
   148	    cited = cited.split("head/", 1)[1] if cited.startswith("head/") else cited
   149	    cited = cited.split("base/", 1)[1] if cited.startswith("base/") else cited
   150	    if cited == defect_file or defect_file.endswith("/" + cited):
   151	        return True
   152	    return cited == defect_file.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
   153	
   154	detected, missed = [], []
   155	for d in man.get("defects", []):
   156	    sites = d.get("anchors") or [d["anchor_line"]]
   157	    hit = any(path_matches(p, d["file"]) and not (b < s - 3 or a > s + 3)
   158	              for p, a, b in cites for s in sites)
   159	    (detected if hit else missed).append(d["id"])
   160	
   161	planted = len(man.get("defects", []))
   162	recall = round(len(detected) / planted, 4) if planted else None
   163	
   164	# refuted share (1.2.0): distinct cited findings that touch no defect site and
   165	# no fix region. Regions are (file, lo, hi) on head/ line numbers, widened ±3.
   166	regions = []
   167	for d in man.get("defects", []):
   168	    for s in (d.get("anchors") or [d["anchor_line"]]):
   169	        regions.append((d["file"], s - 3, s + 3))
   170	for fr in man.get("fix_regions", []) or []:
   171	    try:
   172	        regions.append((fr["file"], int(fr["start"]) - 3, int(fr["end"]) + 3))
   173	    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
   174	        continue
   175	findings = sorted(set(cites))
   176	refuted = [c for c in findings
   177	           if not any(path_matches(c[0], f) and not (c[2] < lo or c[1] > hi) for f, lo, hi in regions)]
   178	refuted_share = round(len(refuted) / len(findings), 4) if findings else None
   179	
   180	# trailer → severity counts (false positives on clean fixtures)
   181	sev = None
   182	tm = TRAILER.search(text)
   183	if tm:
   184	    try:
   185	        sev = json.loads(tm.group(1)).get("counts")
   186	    except Exception:
   187	        sev = None
   188	if isinstance(sev, dict):
   189	    fp = int(sev.get("critical", 0) or 0) + int(sev.get("high", 0) or 0)
   190	else:
   191	    fp = len({(p, a, b) for p, a, b in cites})
   192	false_positives = fp if planted == 0 else 0
   193	
   194	model = effort = None
   195	tokens = None
   196	try:
   197	    ex = json.load(open(executor_path))
   198	    model, effort = ex.get("model_id"), ex.get("effort")
   199	    u = ex.get("usage") or {}
   200	    # every token the call consumed: uncached input, cache writes, cache
   201	    # reads and output — the prompt surface is mostly CACHED input, so
   202	    # input_tokens alone (30 on a real run) would hide the very thing the
   203	    # prompt diet changes
   204	    tokens = sum(int(u.get(k, 0) or 0) for k in
   205	                 ("input_tokens", "cache_creation_input_tokens", "cache_read_input_tokens", "output_tokens"))
   206	except Exception:
   207	    pass
   208	
   209	if planted:
   210	    ok = len(missed) == 0
   211	    score = int(round(recall * 100))
   212	else:
   213	    ok = false_positives == 0
   214	    score = 100 if ok else 0
   215	
   216	out = {
   217	    "pass": ok,
   218	    "score": score,
   219	    "details": {
   220	        "recall": recall, "planted": planted, "detected": detected, "missed": missed,
   221	        "false_positives": false_positives, "severity_counts": sev,
   222	        "citations": len(cites), "model": model, "effort": effort, "tokens": tokens,
   223	        "findings_cited": len(findings), "findings_refuted": len(refuted),
   224	        "refuted_share": refuted_share,
   225	    },
   226	    "grader_version": "1.2.0",
   227	}
   228	print(json.dumps(out))
   229	sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
   230	PY

# Skill Frontmatter Invariants

SKILL.md frontmatter keys interact across two permission layers: the skill's own `capabilities` / `allowed-tools` declarations, and Claude Code's per-agent-type tool allowlist. When the two disagree, the agent-type allowlist wins — silently. Agents that declare write capability but dispatch through a read-only agent type produce correct output and then refuse to persist it.

## The invariant

When a skill declares write capability — either `capabilities.write_files: true` OR `allowed-tools` listing `Write`/`Edit` — it MUST NOT set `agent:` to a type that excludes those tools.

Allowed: omit the `agent:` key (skill runs in the caller's context), or set `agent:` to a write-capable type (`general-purpose`, `claude`, `fork`).

> ## Control arms and the record corpus (cycle-129 FR-2)
> 
> Each recall suite pre-registers control arms in `ab.arms` (review: `baseline`, `no_companion`
> (informational), `no_karpathy`, `no_rule_files`; audit: `baseline`, `no_audit_delta`) and the verdict rule
> in `ab.threshold`. `execute-agent.sh` applies an arm (`LOA_EVAL_ARM`) to the sandbox copy only, after
> materialisation and immediately before the executor starts, and fails the trial (exit 2) when a toggle
> cannot take effect; `executor.json` records `arm`, `arm_toggles`, `arm_evidence`, `source_commit`,
> `models_used` and `refusal_fallbacks`. The executor never inherits the calling Claude Code session's
> coupling, and its subagent model is pinned to `EVAL_MODEL`.
> 
> The record fixtures `pr-11` … `pr-18` are the round-1 states of sprints 247–254, built by
> `harness/seed-corpus-from-record.sh` from `review-prs/record-pairs.tsv` and the `record/cycle-12x-a2a`
> branches. A feedback finding becomes a label only when the fix commit touches the file it cites. Labels
> live in the hidden `review-prs/labels/pr-NN.tsv` (never in the sandbox-copied `pr-NN/`), every drop is
> explained in `labels/pr-NN.dropped.txt`, and hand curation is the data file `labels/curation.tsv`,
> re-applied on every seed. `fix` rows (the hunks the fix commit changed) feed the grader's refuted share
> only. A label file is approved with `seed-corpus-from-record.sh --approve pr-NN --by "<who> <date>"`;
> `run-arms.sh` refuses unapproved fixtures unless `--allow-unapproved`.
> 
> ```bash
> # one suite, one batch, against a detached worktree pinned at the source commit
> ./evals/harness/run-arms.sh --suite review-recall --arms baseline,no_companion,no_karpathy,no_rule_files \
>   --fixtures pr-01,pr-02,pr-03,pr-04,pr-05,pr-06,pr-07,pr-08 --trials 3 --source-commit 864069f2 --dry-run
> ./evals/harness/report.sh --arms            # refuses until STATUS.json is complete; --partial for interim
> ./evals/harness/compare.sh --ab --arm-a evals/results/arms/review-recall/<batch>/baseline \
>   --arm-b evals/results/arms/review-recall/<batch>/no_karpathy --metric recall
> ```

continue
    }

    # For framework tasks, there's no agent execution — just run graders directly.
    # cycle-124 S3 (FR-9): a task that declares `.agent.skill` runs the headless
    # CLI in the sandbox first (execute-agent.sh); every other task keeps the
    # exact pre-existing path. An executor failure (CLI non-zero / timeout /
    # missing binary) is an infrastructure error, never a graded zero — a
    # session cap must not read as a recall drop.
    local agent_skill=""
    agent_skill="$(yq -r '.agent.skill // ""' "$task_file" 2>/dev/null || echo "")"
    local executor_json="null"
    if [[ -n "$agent_skill" && "$agent_skill" != "null" ]]; then
      local exec_exit=0
      "$HARNESS_DIR/execute-agent.sh" \
        --task-yaml "$task_file" --workspace "$sandbox_path" \
        --run-id "$RUN_ID" --trial-id "$trial_id" --timeout "$timeout_trial" \
        >/dev/null 2>"$RUN_DIR/exec-${task_id}-trial-${trial_num}.log" || exec_exit=$?
      if [[ -f "$sandbox_path/.eval/executor.json" ]]; then
        executor_json="$(cat "$sandbox_path/.eval/executor.json")"
      fi
      if [[ $exec_exit -ne 0 ]]; then
        local trial_end_ms
        trial_end_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
        jq -cn \
          --arg run_id "$RUN_ID" \
          --arg task_id "$task_id" \
          --argjson trial "$trial_num" \
          --arg timestamp "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
          --argjson duration_ms "$(( trial_end_ms - trial_start_ms ))" \
          --arg model_version "none" \
          --argjson executor "$executor_json" \
          --arg msg "execute-agent exit $exec_exit" \
          --argjson schema_version 1 \
          '{run_id:$run_id,task_id:$task_id,trial:$trial,timestamp:$timestamp,duration_ms:$duration_ms,
            model_version:$model_version,status:"error",graders:[],executor:$executor,
            composite:{strategy:"all_must_pass",pass:false,score:0},
            error:{type:"agent_error",message:$msg},schema_version:$schema_version,
            arm:(env.LOA_EVAL_ARM // ($executor.arm? // "baseline")),
            source_commit:($executor.source_commit? // env.LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT // null),
            model_id:($executor.model_id? // null)}' \
          >> "$task_result_file"
        _keep_trial_artifacts "$task_file" "$sandbox_path" "$task_id" "$trial_num"
        "$HARNESS_DIR/sandbox.sh" destroy --trial-id "$trial_id" 2>/dev/null || true
        continue
      fi
    fi

    # Run graders
    local grade_output=""
    local grade_exit=0
    grade_output="$("$HARNESS_DIR/grade.sh" \
      --task-yaml "$task_file" \
      --workspace "$sandbox_path" \
      --timeout "$timeout_grader" 2>/dev/null)" || grade_exit=$?

    local trial_end_ms
    trial_end_ms="$(date +%s%N | cut -c1-13)"
    local trial_duration=$(( trial_end_ms - trial_start_ms ))

    # Parse grader results
    local graders_json composite_json status_str error_json
    if echo "$grade_output" | jq . &>/dev/null; then
      graders_json="$(echo "$grade_output" | jq '.graders')"
      composite_json="$(echo "$grade_output" | jq '.composite')"
    else
      graders_json="[]"
      composite_json='{"strategy":"all_must_pass","pass":false,"score":0}'
    fi

    case $grade_exit in
      0) status_str="completed" ; error_json="null" ;;
      1) status_str="completed" ; error_json="null" ;;
      2) status_str="error"     ; error_json='{"type":"infrastructure_error","message":"Grader error"}' ;;
      *) status_str="error"     ; error_json='{"type":"infrastructure_error","message":"Unknown grader exit: '"$grade_exit"'"}' ;;
    esac

    # model_version: the id the CLI echoed for agent tasks (compare.sh's
    # model-skew detection keys on it); "none" for framework tasks as before.
    local model_version="none"
    if [[ "$executor_json" != "null" ]]; then
      model_version="$(jq -r '.model_id // "none"' <<<"$executor_json")"
    fi

    # Write per-trial result (compact JSONL)
    jq -cn \
      --arg run_id "$RUN_ID" \
      --arg task_id "$task_id" \
      --argjson trial "$trial_num" \
      --arg timestamp "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
      --argjson duration_ms "$trial_duration" \
      --arg model_version "$model_version" \
      --arg status "$status_str" \
      --argjson graders "$graders_json" \
      --argjson composite "$composite_json" \
      --argjson error "$error_json" \
      --argjson executor "$executor_json" \
      --argjson schema_version 1 \
      '{run_id:$run_id,task_id:$task_id,trial:$trial,timestamp:$timestamp,duration_ms:$duration_ms,
        model_version:$model_version,status:$status,graders:$graders,composite:$composite,
        error:$error,schema_version:$schema_version}
       + (if $executor == null then {} else {executor:$executor, arm:($executor.arm // "baseline"),
            source_commit:($executor.source_commit // $executor.prompt_tree_commit // null),
            model_id:($executor.model_id // null)} end)' \
      >> "$task_result_file"

    # Keep per-trial agent outputs (AC-9.2 wants them committed with the A/B)
    [[ "$executor_json" != "null" ]] && _keep_trial_artifacts "$task_file" "$sandbox_path" "$task_id" "$trial_num"

    # Cleanup sandbox
    "$HARNESS_DIR/sandbox.sh" destroy --trial-id "$trial_id" 2>/dev/null || true

    # Track pass/fail for early stopping
    local trial_passed
    trial_passed="$(echo "${composite_json:-{}}" | jq -r '.pass // false' 2>/dev/null || echo "false")"
    if [[ "$trial_passed" == "true" ]]; then
      es_passes=$((es_passes + 1))
    else
      es_failures=$((es_failures + 1))
    fi
